## Why visit

A rewarding hidden Salford pub with several old rooms, etched glass and a tiled drinking lobby. The live-music venue occupies the neighbouring property, so the attraction is both an intimate traditional pub and the possibility of a small gig. Holt’s cask makes this a useful regional-brewery stop. It pairs particularly well with the more expansive selection at New Oxford: one visit for the range, the other for the building and local brewery character. Check the music calendar if you want the full experience.

## Beer

CAMRA documents Joseph Holt Bitter and Two Hoots, with a changing beer often from Bootleg.

## Cider and perry

**Cider reported; qualification needs checking.** CAMRA mentions Old Rosie on handpull but does not flag real cider. Do not infer qualification from dispense method.

See [how cider is classified](../real-cider.md).

## Food

Not established; do not plan a meal here without checking.

## Plan the visit

Gig tickets are separate from an ordinary pub visit. Weekday opening is later than lunchtime in the current sources.

**Getting there:** Walk from Salford Central or Victoria; use the precise Collier Street address because the pub is away from main thoroughfares.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
